title: Depth of each branch
statementMd:
Report the maximum depth (number of management levels below the top) of the reporting tree as `max_depth`, where a top manager is depth 0.

Expected columns: `max_depth`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH RECURSIVE t(id, depth) AS (SELECT id, 0 FROM employees WHERE manager_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.id, t.depth + 1 FROM employees e JOIN t ON e.manager_id = t.id) SELECT MAX(depth) AS max_depth FROM t;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
